map.产后出血(预估失血量)计算器 使用指南: Postpartum Hemorrhage (Estimated Blood Loss) Calculator User Guide
map.输入血染敷料总重与干敷料重，按 (总重 − 干重) ÷ 1.05（血液比重）称重: Enter the total weight of blood-soaked dressings and the dry dressing weight and estimate postpartum blood loss with the gravimetric method (total - dry) / 1.05 (blood specific gravity), then assess severity with the shock index. Used for postpartum hemorrhage monitoring in obstetrics.
map.失血量 = (血染敷料湿重 − 干重) / 1.05（g ≈ mL）；伤克指数: Blood loss = (wet weight of blood-soaked dressings - dry weight) / 1.05 (g is about mL); shock index SI = heart rate / systolic pressure
map.失血量 ≥ 500 mL 为产后出血；SI 1.5 重度伤克。: Blood loss of 500 mL or more is postpartum hemorrhage; SI  1.5 means severe shock.
map.用称重法（纱布湿重−干重）/1.05 估算失血。: Estimate blood loss with the gravimetric method (wet gauze - dry gauze) / 1.05.
map.按失血量分级启动相应处理。: Start the matching response by blood loss grade.
map.用休克指数（SI）判断失血程度。: Use the shock index (SI) to judge the severity of blood loss.
map.：血纱布湿重 500g、干重 300g：失血 = (500−300) ÷ 1.0: Blood-stained gauze at 500 g wet and 300 g dry: blood loss = (500 - 300)/1.05 = about 190.5 mL, which is within the normal range of postpartum bleeding since it is under 500 mL.
map.：实测失血 1200mL（≥1000）：判严重产后出血，建立双静脉、备血、促宫缩: Measured blood loss 1200 mL (at or above 1000) is severe postpartum hemorrhage: establish two IV lines, prepare blood, give uterotonics and evaluate uterine compression suturing or interventional options.
map.血液比重约 1.05 g/mL，湿重与干重之差为血液质量（克），除以 1.05: Blood has a specific gravity of about 1.05 g/mL, so the difference between wet and dry weight is the mass of blood in grams; dividing by 1.05 converts it to millilitres of blood loss.
map.休克指数怎么用？: How Do I Use the Shock Index?
map.SI = 心率÷收缩压；SI 0.9 内正常，1.1 约失血 500–1000m: SI = heart rate / systolic pressure; SI below 0.9 is normal, 1.1 suggests about 500-1000 mL blood loss, 1.5 about 1000-1500 mL, and 2.0 or above is severe shock requiring massive transfusion.
